answer: The Bug report with a fix accepted by the project lead backed by a reputation bond ties standing to delivered value: the bug report with a fix is reviewed line by line, the reputation bond is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so an identity is earned by doing something useful, not by filling in a form. Even a quiet falcon gets heard, because review weighs substance, not volume. A terrace and a hollow may look alike, but only the identity with consistently accepted work is honoured.
